severity: ROOT CAUSE of run 3's policy collapse; affects the interpretation of every prior RL run
finding: The alpha update is `-alpha * (logp + TARGET_ENTROPY)`, whose equilibrium is at logp = -TARGET_ENTROPY = +8.4. But default_target_entropy()'s docstring defines -8.4 as a TARGET LOG-DENSITY ('-8.4 corresponds to an exploration std of ~0.20'). The implemented equilibrium and the documented intent differ by a sign.

run_3.outcome: policy stopped moving; reach and grasp 0.20 -> 0.00, mean_disp_m 0.0091

original_rlpd_415k.note: Started FAR ABOVE the +8.4 equilibrium and was still descending when the run ended. The same update that concentrated run 3's policy was, for the original run, correctly reducing an over-dispersed one.

why_this_was_missed: A pre-run check verified that logp = -8.4 is REACHABLE by the correlated noise distribution (it is, near std 0.05-0.1). Reachability and CONVERGENCE are different properties: the alpha update never targets -8.4, so reachability was necessary but not sufficient. The check should have driven the alpha update to its fixed point and asserted where it lands.
diagnostic_process_note: Two intermediate analyses were wrong and were corrected before reporting. A hand-derivation produced 'alpha falls for every input', which is internally contradictory; and an empirical test using Adam at lr=0.1 showed identical behaviour for every logp, because Adam's normalised step hides gradient direction. Only plain SGD exposed the true gradient.
implication_for_prior_results: The 415k checkpoint that the whole study analyses was trained under this same formula. Its behaviour is therefore not a bug artefact -- it was trained toward logp=+8.4 throughout, i.e. with steadily decreasing exploration. This does not invalidate the specification-gaming finding, which is a measurement of the trained policy's geometry and independent of how it was trained.

options_not_yet_chosen.A_fix_the_residual: Use (logp - TARGET_ENTROPY) so equilibrium is logp = -8.4, matching the documented intent. CONFOUND: run 4 would then use a different entropy target than the checkpoint it warm-starts from, and than every prior run.
options_not_yet_chosen.B_document_and_keep: Correct the docstring to state the true equilibrium (+8.4) and keep the formula, preserving comparability. Does not fix the collapse.
options_not_yet_chosen.C_floor_alpha: Keep the formula but prevent alpha reaching zero, so the entropy term cannot vanish. Least invasive, but treats the symptom.

status: Diagnosed and recorded. No change made yet -- the choice affects comparability with every prior run.

resolution.chosen: Option A -- correct the residual to (logp - TARGET_ENTROPY).
resolution.rationale: The documented intent is the correct one: -8.4 was chosen as a reachable target log-density corresponding to exploration std ~0.20, specifically so alpha could correct in BOTH directions. A policy driven toward logp=+8.4 becomes near-deterministic and cannot explore at all, so comparability with a target that paralyses the policy buys nothing.
resolution.confound_declared: Any run using the corrected residual has a DIFFERENT entropy target than the 415k checkpoint it warm-starts from and than every prior run in this study. That is a genuine confound and is declared here rather than discovered later: such a run is a new configuration, not a continuation.
resolution.reproducibility: ENTROPY_RESIDUAL_LEGACY=1 restores the original residual exactly, so the prior arms remain reproducible. Every run records both the flag and alpha_fixed_point_logp -- where its alpha update actually converges -- so a result can never be misread as having used the documented target when it used the negation.
resolution.test_that_would_have_caught_it: tests/unit_tests/test_g1_piston_entropy_alpha_fixed_point.py drives the real update to convergence and asserts where it lands, from both sides. The pre-run check that MISSED this only verified the target was reachable by the noise distribution; that test is retained in the same file, labelled 'necessary but NOT sufficient', so the distinction between reachability and convergence stays visible.
resolution.status: IMPLEMENTED. 9 tests on the fixed point; 265 g1_piston tests pass.
